TIREKICK does not make claims about engine condition from audio. The anomaly detector has not been measured against a labelled set, so under our own accuracy rules it cannot appear in a report. What is below is the recording itself, drawn as a spectrogram, and the measurements taken from it. Listen to the clip yourself, and play it to a mechanic at a cold start.
